messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 7):
"""
An Insurer shall not deny the renewal on the ground that the policyholder had made a claim (s) in the preceding policy years. c. An Insurer shall not resort to fresh underwriting unless there is an increase in sum insured. In case increase in sum insured is requested by the policyholder, the Insurer may underwrite only to the extent of increased sum insured. 11) Migration in case of Indemnity policies: In case of migration of one policy to another with the same Insurer, the policyholder (including all members under family cover and group insurance policies) can transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, Specific Waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing diseases, Moratorium period etc. in the previous policy to the migrated policy. 12) Portability in case of Indemnity Policies: a.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Can an insurer refuse to renew a health insurance policy simply because the policyholder has made a claim in previous policy years?","answer":"No, an insurer cannot deny renewal on the ground that the policyholder had made a claim in the preceding policy years.","facts":["An Insurer shall not deny the renewal on the ground that the policyholder had made a claim (s) in the preceding policy years"]},{"question":"If a policyholder requests an increase in sum insured, can the insurer require fresh underwriting for the entire policy?","answer":"No, the insurer may underwrite only to the extent of the increased sum insured and must not resort to fresh underwriting unless there is an increase in sum insured.","facts":["An Insurer shall not resort to fresh underwriting unless there is an increase in sum insured","In case increase in sum insured is requested by the policyholder, the Insurer may underwrite only to the extent of increased sum insured"]}]}
